description: Pretty-print or minify XML with a real tokenizer that handles comments, CDATA, and self-closing tags.

faqs.a: Elements, attributes, comments, CDATA sections, processing instructions, DOCTYPE declarations, and self-closing tags are all handled.
You get a precise error message, e.g. a mismatched closing tag or an unclosed element, instead of silent garbage output.
Only if you tick the remove-comments option. CDATA content is always preserved either way.
No. Everything runs in your browser; nothing leaves your device.

howto: Paste your XML into the input box.
Choose Pretty-print or Minify and pick an indent style.
Click Format — the result appears below, ready to copy or download.
